notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Ace of Space has been updated with new functionality:

Steam cloud saves.

Audial and visual feedback for interface buttons.

Player's spaceship now moves at a steady speed when not being controlled. Destruction by going out of bounds now should not be possible.

Serious optimization improvements.

Progress reset button now reuires three presses in quick succession to be activated to prevent accidental triggering.

Have fun!
